create_encoder04: create an Encoder04 instance with a given image size and optional encoder dimension
run_encoder04_forward: run the Encoder04 forward pass on a batch of image tensors to produce encoded feature maps
get_encoder04_dim: get the encoder dimension from an Encoder04 instance
build_resnet18_encoder: build a modified resnet-18 encoder that outputs square feature maps of configurable size
review_encoder04_class: review the Encoder04 class that wraps a truncated resnet-18 for image encoding
